dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: #The village is real dangerous, {F#big sis}{M#big bro}. Is there anything that I, Konda Takeru, can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of dangers lie within this village?

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Heh, since you bothered to ask with such sincerity, allow me to fill you in on the horrors of this place!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: The village is filled with mysterious incidents and dangers. For instance, my grandfather would never let me near that dried well...

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: However! I know that the Treasure Whirlpool lies within that well! Greedy treasure hunters would get sucked into the huge, horrifying whirlpool at the bottom of the well and become trapped by the monsters inside!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Well, you don't seem ready yet. I mean, look at me! I can already fully take care of myself!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Someday, I'm gonna become as reliable as someone like Ryuuji. That way, I'll be able to protect you and everyone in the village!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Ryuuji is a hero who once saved my life. He's helping to keep the peace in Inazuma as part of the, uh... the Manban Sanpou something-or-other!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Once, when I got stuck on a cliff while running around outside, Ryuuji dropped down from the skies and saved me.

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: I want to become a great hero just like Ryuuji. That way, I can help my dad who's in the army to fight off all the bad guys in the rebellion!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you not going to play with your "Aunt"?

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: "Aunt"? Oh, you mean that old hag? She's such a sore loser — I'm not gonna play with her!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Every time she loses, she pulls a long face and says "You have to listen to me, you're my nephew." And she's not even as tall as me! Aaand she's always trying to cheat!

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: But I won't hold a grudge against her. I'm the man who's gonna become as strong as Ryuuji, after all!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not at the moment. See you soon.

dialogues.speaker: Takeru
dialogues.text: Alright then... Well, let me know if you ever need help with anything! Remember, I'm the trustworthy Konda Takeru!
